bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than A4 are not permitted at some events. The hall asks guests not to bring large handbags or rucksacks.
allowed: Bags up to A4 (at events with the A4 rule)
prohibited: Bags larger than A4 at some events
Sound and image recording devices for commercial use
bagPolicy.note: Bags larger than A4 can be checked for €5 at the bag drop in front of the hall, to the right of the main entrance. The cloakroom takes coats and belongings for €3.

parking.note: There are 1,300 parking spaces available at myticket Jahrhunderthalle, typically opening 3 hours before events and costing 8 € on-site. VIP guests have designated parking in area A, and accessible parking is available in area B.

rideshare.note: For a shared car ride, select your event in the Road2Gig app and request an available seat. This option is offered for selected events and is for adults aged 18 or older.

concessions.note: The myticket Jahrhunderthalle offers a variety of food and drink options through its partner Food Affairs, including soft drinks, fine wines, and a selection of spirits. Guests can enjoy Braustübl´ beer from the Darmstädter Privatbrauerei. Premium Lounge guests have access to a fine-dining buffet with corresponding drinks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Guests with a "B" on their disabled pass can bring one companion for free. Tickets for the wheelchair platform or barrier-free seating are usually sold through a separate email address or phone number shown on the event page above the ticket button. A lift serves the hall, and since Höchst Farbwerke S-Bahn station isn't accessible, use Höchst Bahnhof and take a bus or taxi.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in myticket Jahrhunderthalle's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is to the right of the main entrance and usually opens about one hour before the show starts. It currently accepts cash only.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Bags are checked at the entrance, so leave large handbags and backpacks at home to avoid slowing admission. Guests with a VIP Upgrade get a separate entrance or fast lane.
